title: Linear upper bounds for the first Betti number of four-generated numerical semigroups
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization, against Mathlib, of the theorem that the first Betti number (minimal number of generators of the toric ideal) of a numerical semigroup minimally generated by four elements n0 < n1 < n2 < n3 is at most 2W, where W = (n3 - n0) / gcd(n1 - n0, n2 - n0, n3 - n0); in particular at most twice the width n3 - n0.  This replaces the conjectured quadratic bound (w+1 choose 2) of Herzog–Stamate (2014) and Caviglia–Moscariello–Sammartano (2024) in embedding dimension four; the bound 2w is attained for every width w >= 4 (an informal companion result; sharpness is not formalized).
